structures.ddl: CREATE VIEW big_orders AS SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE total > 100;
CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email varchar(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name text);

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("sku") REFERENCES "products" ("sku") ON DELETE SET DEFAULT

structures.ddl:
CREATE TABLE line_items (
  order_id integer,
  line integer,
  sku text,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, line),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
  CONSTRAINT line_product FOREIGN KEY (sku) REFERENCES products(sku) ON DELETE SET DEFAULT
);
CREATE TABLE "Mixed Case" ("Id" int PRIMARY KEY, "a""b" text, [odd col] varchar);

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customers" ("id") ON UPDATE SET NULL ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: orders_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_audit AFTER DELETE ON orders BEGIN SELECT 1; END

triggers.name: orders_touch
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT 1; END

structures.ddl: CREATE TABLE products (sku text PRIMARY KEY, name text) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE tree (id integer PRIMARY KEY, parent integer REFERENCES tree(id));
